skill.name: when-debugging-code-use-debugging-assistant
skill.description: Structured debugging workflow for identifying symptoms, finding root causes, generating fixes, validating tests, and preventing regressions.
skill.summary: Guide debugging from symptom capture through validated regression prevention.
skill.author: DNYoussef

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples, Graphviz labels, and /dev/null redirection. The executable shell workflow has real risks from eval on a project-configured test command and repeated npx execution of a mutable alpha package. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Project configuration can control a shell command executed with eval.
remediation.suggestion: Replace eval with an explicit command array, an allowlist of known test commands, or a confirmation prompt before execution.

remediation.issue: The workflow runs npx claude-flow@alpha at runtime.
remediation.suggestion: Pin claude-flow to an exact version and document the external dependency, or require explicit user approval before invoking npx.

remediation.issue: Debug context can include logs, git history, and phase notes stored through external tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Document what data is stored, avoid sensitive logs by default, and provide an opt-in mode for external memory operations.

semantic_findings.title: Configurable Test Command Uses eval

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The data flow is direct: jq reads testCommand from local config, assigns DEBUG_TEST_CMD, and eval executes it during validation.

content.user_title: Debug Code with Root Cause Analysis
content.value_statement: Debugging can stall when symptoms, causes, fixes, and tests are handled separately. This skill guides a five-phase workflow for diagnosis, repair, validation, and regression prevention.
actual_capabilities: Captures symptoms with errors, logs, reproduction steps, and environment details.
Structures root cause analysis with tracing, boundary checks, and recent change review.
Prompts fix generation with tradeoff analysis and implementation notes.
Guides validation through test execution and regression coverage planning.
Stores phase outputs under debugging memory keys for coordinated sessions.
limitations: Requires access to relevant source code, logs, and a usable test environment.
Does not guarantee correct fixes without developer review and validation.
The shell command can run configured test commands and claude-flow hooks.
Some automation expects Claude Code and claude-flow tooling to be available.

use_cases.title: Diagnose a Production Regression
use_cases.description: Trace a reported failure from symptoms to root cause, then prepare a tested fix plan.

use_cases.title: Turn Failures into Regression Tests
use_cases.description: Convert a failing scenario into reproduction steps, validation tests, and prevention notes.

use_cases.title: Standardize Bug Fix Reviews
use_cases.description: Collect consistent debug reports that explain cause, fix choice, validation, and follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Bug Investigation
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the debugging assistant to investigate this issue: [describe the problem]. Ask for any missing reproduction details first.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Failing Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the debugging workflow on this failing test: [test name and failure]. Identify the likely root cause and needed validation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Fix Options
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply the fix generation phase to this root cause: [root cause]. Compare two approaches and recommend the safer change.

prompt_templates.title: Debug a Multi-Service Regression
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the full five-phase debugging process for this cross-service regression: [incident summary]. Include validation and prevention steps.

output_examples.input: Users see a login error after a recent deployment.
output: Symptom summary lists the failing path, observed error, affected users, and reproduction status.
Root cause analysis focuses on recent authentication changes and missing user object validation.
Validation plan includes the login regression test and a negative case for missing user data.

output_examples.input: A checkout test fails intermittently during parallel runs.
output: The workflow separates timing symptoms from data corruption symptoms.
The likely cause is framed as a shared state or ordering issue that needs isolation.
Prevention steps include a deterministic regression test and notes for future reviewers.

output_examples.input: A memory leak appears after adding event listeners.
output: The report identifies listener lifecycle checks as the main investigation path.
The fix plan emphasizes cleanup behavior and measurable memory validation.
Regression prevention adds teardown checks and monitoring notes.

best_practices: Provide exact error text, reproduction steps, recent changes, and affected files.
Run the proposed validation tests before accepting any generated fix.
Review command automation and project configuration before enabling the shell workflow.
anti_patterns: Changing code before the issue is reproducible or clearly scoped.
Suppressing a failing test without proving the underlying cause.
Running untrusted project test commands without reviewing local configuration first.

faq.question: What does this skill help debug?
faq.answer: It helps investigate runtime errors, test failures, regressions, performance issues, and integration failures.

faq.question: Does it edit code automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow can guide fixes, but developers should review every change and validation result.

faq.question: Does it require Claude Flow?
faq.answer: The documentation and shell command reference claude-flow hooks and memory for coordinated sessions.

faq.question: Can it handle incomplete bug reports?
faq.answer: Yes. It starts by identifying missing symptoms, reproduction steps, environment details, and logs.

faq.question: How should teams validate a fix?
faq.answer: Run the failing case, related unit tests, integration tests, and any regression test added for the issue.

faq.question: What should users review before running automation?
faq.answer: Review local debug configuration, test commands, log paths, and any external tool invocation.
